short_description: Mars Exploration Rover Pancam left camera L5 (geology) filter

licence.terms: "Unless the data file is marked with a restrictive notice or license, data that is provided from a NASA-led mission including observations, engineering, calibration, and auxiliary data are licensed as Creative Commons Zero" "There are no restrictions on the usage of these data."
licence.scope: NASA Science Data Licenses statement (owner's data terms, step 2): data from a NASA-led mission, including calibration data, is CC0 unless the file carries a restrictive notice. It covers NASA mission data in general; the PanCam filter page itself was not found to carry its own notice; the instrument paper (Bell et al. 2003, JGR) was not checked for terms. Same record as MER/MI. SVO cites https://mars.nasa.gov/mer/mission/instruments/pancam/ (now redirects to https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-exploration-rovers-spirit-and-opportunity/science-instruments/). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Regardless of the license, users are encouraged to cite the original source of the data and the usage of the repository when appropriate.
